einzeiler: Robin Hood helps a distressed knight and encounters the Bishop of Hereford.
kurzfassung: Robin Hood encounters a sorrowful knight named Sir Richard of the Lee and learns his lands are pawned due to a heavy debt. Later, Little John captures the wealthy Bishop of Hereford and brings him to the forest camp. Robin redistributes the bishop's gold to pay off Sir Richard's debt and sends the knight home with an armed escort and gifts.
stichpunkte: Robin Hood sets out into the forest to find a guest for a woodland feast and encounters a sorrowful knight.
Sir Richard of the Lee explains that his lands are pawned to a priory because he had to pay a massive ransom for his son.
Little John captures the Lord Bishop of Hereford along with packhorses carrying valuable goods and a chest of gold.
Robin opens the bishop's iron-bound box, revealing fifteen hundred pounds of the king's money.
Robin divides the confiscated wealth, keeping a portion for charity and the forest men while returning some to the bishop.
Five hundred pounds of the bishop's money are given to Sir Richard to pay off his debt to the priory.
Sir Richard departs for home escorted by Little John and twenty men, receiving a gold chain, spurs, and velvet for his wife.
The Bishop of Hereford is required to stay in the greenwood for three days of hunting before being released.

clips.hook: Only ten shillings in the wide world
clips.text: Sir Richard confesses that his entire worldly wealth consists of a mere ten shillings in his purse.

clips.hook: A noble estate forfeited for a pittance
clips.text: Robin reacts with intense anger upon discovering that the knight's entire property is at stake over a debt of only four hundred pounds.
Little John sorrowfully admits to hurling various insulting nicknames at the bishop.
Will Scarlet smashes open the locked iron chest, spilling out a massive hoard of gold that totals fifteen hundred pounds.
Sir Richard vows eternal gratitude and promises that his castle walls will be defended against any harm on behalf of the outlaws.
